question: Decision of the European Parliament and immediate suspension of the EUMercosur agreement

On 21 January 2026, the European Parliament adopted a resolution requesting an opinion from the CJEU on whether the proposed partnership agreement between the EU and Mercosur was compatible with the Treaties. That vote represents a historic decision to defend farmers across Europe, including Galician farmers.

At a time marked by great uncertainty and social protests, food sovereignty and respect for the will of the people must be ensured – and the first steps towards that are protecting the interests of those who feed us every day and respecting the will of thousands of European farmers, expressed in the outcome of the vote in the European Parliament.

The division of the EU-Mercosur agreement into the Partnership Agreement and the Interim Trade Agreement has raised concerns. The European Commission and President von der Leyen should freeze the current EUMercosur Partnership Agreement and the Interim Trade Agreement until the CJEU rules on their compliance with EU law; they should thereby respect the will of Parliament.
Will the Commission respect the outcome of the vote in the European Parliament and wait for the opinion of the CJEU?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (27.2.2026) The Commission acknowledges the European Parliament's resolution and reaffirms its commitment to adhere to the rules and procedures set out in the EU Treaties. The Commission is dedicated to fostering sincere cooperation among all EU institutions, respecting the role of the European Parliament in the ratification process.
